description: This file defines the FocusBehavior class in the Kivy framework, providing keyboard focus management and cycling among widgets, including focus initialization, focus traversal, and keyboard event handling.

classes.name: FocusBehavior
classes.description: Provides keyboard focus management, cycling focus among widgets, handling focus initialization, and keyboard event processing within the Kivy framework.

methods.name: _set_keyboard
methods.description: Assigns a keyboard to the widget, managing focus and keyboard binding.

methods.name: _get_keyboard
methods.description: Retrieves the current keyboard bound to the widget.

methods.name: _on_focusable
methods.description: Handles changes to focusability, unfocusing widget if disabled or not focusable.

methods.name: _on_focus
methods.description: Handles focus state changes, binding or unbinding keyboard based on focus.

methods.name: _ensure_keyboard
methods.description: Requests a keyboard if none is bound.

methods.name: _bind_keyboard
methods.description: Binds keyboard events to the widget when focused.

methods.name: _unbind_keyboard
methods.description: Unbinds keyboard events and releases keyboard if in managed mode.

methods.name: keyboard_on_textinput
methods.description: Placeholder for handling text input; currently does nothing.

methods.name: _keyboard_released
methods.description: Handles keyboard release, unfocusing the widget.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events to focus widget if touched.

methods.name: _handle_post_on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles post-touch-up events to unfocus widgets if needed.

methods.name: _get_focus_next
methods.description: Finds the next focusable widget in focus order.

methods.name: get_focus_next
methods.description: Returns the next focusable widget in focus order.

methods.name: get_focus_previous
methods.description: Returns the previous focusable widget in focus order.

methods.name: keyboard_on_key_down
methods.description: Handles key down events, managing focus cycling with Tab and Shift+Tab.

methods.name: keyboard_on_key_up
methods.description: Handles key up events, unfocusing widget on Escape key.

methods.name: show_keyboard
methods.description: Shows the keyboard in managed mode.

methods.name: hide_keyboard
methods.description: Hides the keyboard in managed mode.
